title: A unifying theory of foreign intervention in domestic climate policy
abstract: We propose a theory of climate-policy motivated foreign intervention to study different forms of international climate governance in the presence of power imbalance. Foreign countries have at least three options to intervene in another country’s domestic climate policy: i.) Agreements with Extraction; ii.) Agreements with Transfers; and iii.) Agreements with Sanctions. We distill the fundamental properties of different climate policy options into a simple parameterization and examine the incentivizes and preferences for each type of foreign intervention. We find that the preference for the type of foreign intervention depends critically on the policy externality of different domestic climate policies.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个基于气候政策动机的外国干预理论，用以研究在存在权力不对称的情况下，国际气候治理的不同形式。外国在干预另一国国内气候政策时，至少有三种选择：（i）以资源开采为条件的协议；（ii）以转移支付为条件的协议；以及（iii）以制裁为条件的协议。我们将不同气候政策选项的基本属性归纳为一个简单的参数化形式，并考察各类外国干预的激励与偏好。我们发现，对于外国干预类型的偏好，关键取决于不同国内气候政策的政策外部性。

title: Distribution of Physical Burden of Climate Policy
From Micro-level Weather Shocks to Macroeconomic Impacts
abstract: Weather matters at the local level. Microeconomic climate econometric analyses find evidence that weather has localized effects on labor supply, agricultural yields, mortality rates, and other socio-economic measures. However, macroeconomic analyses at the national level find no evidence that weather affects macroeconomic aggregates, such as GDP or aggregate productivity in the US and other developed economies. These results present a seeming contradiction. In this paper, I develop a general equilibrium theoretical model of an economy with localized weather shocks to bridge the gap between microeconomic and macroeconomic studies. The theoretical model provides a simple, modular framework for aggregating weather shock impacts. I apply the findings to an empirical setting in the US, a prime example of the contradictory findings. I first estimate the microeconomic impacts of weather on labor productivity growth across county-industry pairs in the US from 2002 to 2017. I then apply these to construct annual estimates of the impact of weather shocks across the economy on US GDP according to the theoretical framework. I construct confidence intervals using the estimated microeconomic impact uncertainty. Across the sample years, I find no evidence that the annual impacts are distinct from $0. I then deconstruct the aggregate impacts, again following the theoretical framework, to examine what generates this no-effect result. I find consistent evidence of statistically significant but heterogeneous effects across a majority of counties and industries. For example, within a given year, over two-thirds of counties are consistently and significantly impacted by their local weather. This effect is positive for some counties and negative for others. I show that it is the aggregation of these heterogeneous impacts across the spatial distribution and industrial composition of the economy that masks the impact of weather. This finding highlights the importance of understanding micro-level economic impacts and changes in the composition of economic activity for projections of future macroeconomic climate change impacts.
abstract_zh: 天气在地方层面具有重要影响。微观层面的气候计量分析发现，天气对劳动供给、农业产量、死亡率以及其他社会经济指标具有局部效应。然而，国家层面的宏观经济分析却发现，天气并不影响美国及其他发达经济体的GDP或总体生产率等宏观经济总量。这些结果呈现出一种看似矛盾的局面。在本文中，我们构建了一个存在局部天气冲击的经济体的一般均衡理论模型，以弥合微观与宏观研究之间的差距。该理论模型提供了一个简洁、模块化的框架，用于加总天气冲击的影响。我们将这些发现应用于美国的实证情境，美国正是上述矛盾结果的典型例子。我们首先估计了2002至2017年美国县-行业配对中，天气对劳动生产率增长的微观影响。随后，依据理论框架，利用这些估计结果构建了天气冲击对美国GDP整体影响的年度估计。我们利用所估计的微观影响不确定性构建了置信区间。在各样本年份中，我们没有发现年度影响显著不同于0的证据。随后，我们依据理论框架对总体影响进行分解，以考察产生这一无效应结果的原因。我们发现，在大多数县和行业中，存在统计上显著但异质性的效应，这一结论具有一致性。例如，在给定年份内，超过三分之二的县持续受到显著影响，且受其本地天气影响。这种效应对一些县为正，对另一些县则为负。我们表明，正是这些异质性影响在经济活动的空间分布和行业构成中加总，掩盖了天气的影响。这一发现凸显了理解微观层面经济影响，以及经济活动构成变化，对于预测未来宏观经济气候变化影响的重要性。

title: An Indigenous perspective on climate engineering
abstract: Indigenous Peoples remain uniquely exposed to the threat of anthropogenic climate change, thereby requiring the research community to collaboratively explore (alongside Indigenous organizations and individuals) new approaches to climate risk mitigation. This Perspective assesses one aspect of climate risk mitigation - climate engineering, an umbrella term which we use to encompass emergent negative emissions technologies (like direct air capture) and research into the spectrum of solar radiation management techniques. In this co-produced contribution from both Indigenous and non-Indigenous collaborators, we situate the research within our community-based Indigenous histories. We then outline the nature of Indigenous climate risk as context for arguing that flawed existing attempts to simplistically assess the nexus of Indigeneity and climate risk management (which can prescriptively provide a universal “Indigenous perspective” across a structurally fragmented, highly complex landscape of Indigeneity) need to be abandoned. We propose methodological and engagement ideas for researchers in this space to consider. Of note, the applied focus of this paper concludes with “next steps” direction based on existing models observed within our fifty years of combined experience at the nexus of Indigeneity and community development.
abstract_zh: 原住民仍然独特地暴露于人为气候变化的威胁之下，因此，研究界需要与原住民组织和个人合作，共同探索应对气候风险的新方法。本观点文章评估了气候风险缓解的一个方面——气候工程，这是一个涵盖新兴负排放技术（如直接空气捕集）以及太阳辐射管理各类技术研究的统称。本文由原住民与非原住民合作者共同撰写，我们将研究置于以社区为基础的原住民历史背景之中。随后，我们阐述了原住民气候风险的性质，以论证现有的一些简单化评估尝试应当被摒弃。这些尝试试图探讨原住民身份与气候风险管理之间的关系，却可能规定性地提供一个放之四海而皆准的“原住民视角”，而实际上原住民身份所处的是一个结构性碎片化、高度复杂的格局。我们为该领域的研究人员提出了方法论和参与性研究的思路。值得注意的是，本文的应用性重点以基于我们五十年综合经验的“后续步骤”方向作结，这些经验来自原住民身份与社区发展的交汇领域。

title: Distribution of climate damages in convergence-consistent growth projections
abstract: Climate-econometric estimates assuming that climate changes affect economic growth result in larger projected damages than estimates restricting the effect to economic income levels. We show that the latter is consistent with neoclassical macroeconomic theory by explicitly accounting for income growth convergence in our empirical investigation. We show that accounting for convergence does not statistically change the point estimates capturing climate’s macroeconomic effect, but it has significant implications for assessing the long-term economic consequences of climate change. The magnitude and spread of long-term losses from climate change are reduced. Aggregated damages are found to be convex in the extent of climate change and are projected to continuously increase over time with on-going climate change, in contrast to growth-effects-only estimates where the gains experienced by the winners of climate change eventually surpass the losses incurred by the losers. For example, projections of climate change damages based on climate-econometric estimates by Burke et al., 2015 find that global warming could reduce average global incomes by 20% and drastically increase intercountry income inequality, reflected by a 118% increase in the Gini coefficient in 2100 under RCP8.5. We reestimate and project climate damages under the same scenario accounting for convergence and find global climate damages around 8.5% of global incomes and an increase in intercountry income inequality by 8% in 2100.
abstract_zh: 假设气候变化影响经济增长的气候计量估计，所预测的损害比仅将影响限定于经济收入水平的估计更大。我们表明，后一种设定与新古典宏观经济理论相一致，因为它在实证研究中明确考虑了收入增长的收敛性。我们发现，考虑收敛性并不会在统计上改变捕捉气候宏观经济效应的点估计，但它对评估气候变化的长期经济后果具有重要意义。气候变化造成的长期损失的规模和离散程度均有所降低。我们发现，综合性损害随气候变化程度呈凸性，并随着气候变化的持续而不断增加；而在仅考虑增长效应的估计中，气候变化的受益者所获得的收益最终会超过受损者所遭受的损失。例如，基于Burke等人（2015）的气候计量估计所作的气候损害预测认为，在RCP8.5情景下，全球变暖可能使全球平均收入降低20%，并使国家间收入不平等急剧加剧，到2100年基尼系数将上升118%。我们在考虑收敛性的情况下，在相同情景下重新估计并预测气候损害，发现到2100年全球气候损害约为全球收入的8.5%，国家间收入不平等上升8%。

title: Watts and Bots: The Energy Implications of AI Adoption
abstract:
Rapid expansion of Artificial Intelligence is expected to drive proportional expansion of economic activity through productivity gains–potentially leading to higher energy consumption and associated environmental impacts, including increased carbon dioxide emissions. We combine data on economic activity with early estimates of likely adoption of AI across occupations and industries to quantify the potential change in energy use and carbon dioxide emissions for the United States. At the industry level, we estimate annual increases in energy use ranging from 0 and 12 petajoules (PJ) and carbon emissions from 0 tonnes to 272 kt (ktCO
2
). Aggregated across the economy, AI adoption could lead to an additional 28 PJ of energy use and 896 ktCO
2
in emissions annually–equivalent to approximately 0.03% of annual national energy use and 0.02% of annual national CO
2
emissions. These results highlight the need to account not only for the aggregate energy and environmental implications of AI-driven productivity gains, but also for how these impacts vary across industries based on their specific characteristics.
abstract_zh: 人工智能的快速扩张预计将通过生产率提升推动经济活动的同比例扩张，这可能导致能源消耗增加以及相关环境影响加剧，包括二氧化碳排放增加。我们结合经济活动数据与人工智能在各职业和行业中可能采用的早期估计，量化了美国能源使用和二氧化碳排放的潜在变化。在行业层面，我们估计每年能源使用增加0至12拍焦（PJ），碳排放增加0至272千吨二氧化碳（ktCO2）。在全经济范围内加总来看，人工智能的采用每年可能导致额外28 PJ的能源使用和896 ktCO2的排放，相当于每年全国能源使用量的约0.03%，以及全国年度CO2排放量的约0.02%。这些结果表明，不仅需要考虑人工智能驱动的生产率提升所带来的总体能源和环境影响，还需要考虑这些影响如何因各行业的具体特征而有所不同。

title: Impact of solar geoengineering on temperature-attributable mortality
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Decisions about solar geoengineering (SG) entail risk–risk tradeoffs between the direct risks of SG and SG’s ability to reduce climate risks. Quantitative comparisons between these risks are needed to inform public policy. We evaluate idealized SG’s effectiveness in reducing deaths from warming using two climate models and an econometric analysis of temperature-attributable mortality. We find SG’s impact on temperature-attributable mortality is uneven with decreases for hotter, poorer regions and increases in cooler, richer regions. Relative to no SG, global mortality is reduced by over 400,000 deaths annually [90% CI: (−1.2 million,2.7 million)] for cooling of 1 °C from 2.5 °C above preindustrial in 2080. We find no evidence that mortality reduction achieved by SG is smaller than the reduction from equivalent cooling by emissions reductions. Combining our estimates with existing estimates of sulphate aerosol injection direct mortality risk from air quality and UV-attributable cancer enables the first quantitative risk-risk comparison of SG. We estimate with 61% probability that the mortality benefits of cooling outweigh these direct SG risks. We find the benefits outweigh these risks by 13 times for our central estimates, or 4 deaths per 100,000 per 1 °C per year [90% CI: (−11,23)]. This is not a comprehensive evaluation of the risk–risk tradeoffs around SG, yet by comparing some of the most consequential impacts on human welfare it is a useful first step. While these findings are robust to a variety of alternative assumptions, considerable uncertainties remain and require further investigation.
abstract_zh: 关于太阳地球工程（SG）的决策涉及风险与风险之间的权衡：SG的直接风险，以及SG降低气候风险的能力。为了给公共政策提供参考，需要对这些风险进行定量比较。我们利用两个气候模式和一项关于温度归因死亡率的计量分析，评估了理想化SG在减少因变暖导致的死亡方面的有效性。我们发现，SG对温度归因死亡率的影响并不均衡：在较热、较贫穷的地区死亡率下降，而在较凉爽、较富裕的地区则上升。以2080年相对于工业化前水平高出2.5°C为基准，与无SG情景相比，每降温1°C，全球每年可减少40多万例死亡[90%置信区间：（-120万，270万）]。我们没有发现证据表明，SG所实现的死亡减少幅度，小于通过减排实现同等降温所带来的死亡减少。将我们的估计与现有关于硫酸盐气溶胶注入的直接死亡风险（来自空气质量及紫外线导致的癌症）的估计相结合，我们首次对SG进行了定量的风险-风险比较。我们估计，有61%的概率，降温带来的死亡效益超过这些直接的SG风险。在我们的中心估计中，这些效益超过风险的倍数为13倍，即每年每1°C降温可减少每10万人4例死亡[90%置信区间：（-11，23）]。这并非对SG所涉风险-风险权衡的全面评估，但通过比较对人类福祉影响最为重大的一些方面，它是一个有益的第一步。尽管这些结果在多种替代假设下都是稳健的，但仍存在相当大的不确定性，需要进一步研究。

title: How may solar geoengineering impact global prospects for climate change mitigation?
abstract: As disruptions from climate change increase, so will the urgency to find shorter-term approaches to ameliorating its harms. This may include calls to implement solar geoengineering, an approach to cooling the planet by reflecting incoming sunlight back to space. While the exact effects of solar geoengineering are still highly uncertain, physical science to date suggests that it may be effective at reducing many aspects of climate change in the short term. One of the biggest concerns about solar geoengineering is the extent to which it may interfere with crucial emissions reductions policies, i.e. mitigation. There are multiple channels by which geoengineering could alter mitigation pathways, both financial and behavioural. Here we define three such linkages and present the evidence available to constrain their potential magnitudes. Because solar geoengineering is not a substitute for mitigation, policies to develop or implement technologies that could be used to carry it out should be designed to accentuate its complementary nature to mitigation and deter the possibility it is used to delay decarbonizing the economy.
abstract_zh: 随着气候变化带来的扰动不断增加，寻找短期内减轻其危害的途径的紧迫性也将随之增强。这可能包括呼吁实施太阳地球工程，即通过将入射阳光反射回太空来降低地球温度的一种方法。尽管太阳地球工程的确切效果仍然高度不确定，但目前的物理科学研究表明，它在短期内可能有效减轻气候变化的许多方面的影响。关于太阳地球工程最大的担忧之一，是它可能在多大程度上干扰关键的减排政策，即减缓（mitigation）。太阳地球工程可能通过金融和行为两个渠道改变减缓路径。本文界定了三种此类联系，并呈现了可用于约束其潜在规模的现有证据。由于太阳地球工程并不能替代减缓，因此，为开发或实施可用于开展太阳地球工程的技术而制定的政策，应当着重强调其与减缓的互补性，并防止其被用来拖延经济脱碳进程。

title: The value of information about solar geoengineering and the two-sided cost of bias
abstract: Solar geoengineering (SG) might be able to reduce climate risks if used to supplement emissions cuts and carbon removal. Yet, the wisdom of proceeding with research to reduce its uncertainties is disputed. Here, we use an integrated assessment model to estimate that the value of information that reduces uncertainty about SG efficacy. We find the value of reducing uncertainty by one-third by 2030 is around $4.5 trillion, most of which comes from reduced climate damages rather than reduced mitigation costs. Reducing uncertainty about SG efficacy is similar in value to reducing uncertainty about climate sensitivity. We analyse the cost of over-confidence about SG that causes too little emissions cuts and too much SG. Consistent with concerns about SG’s moral hazard problem, we find an over-confident bias is a serious and costly concern; but, we also find under-confidence that prematurely rules out SG can be roughly as costly. Biased judgments are costly in both directions. A coin has two sides. Our analysis quantitatively demonstrates the risk-risk trade-off around SG and reinforces the value of research that can reduce uncertainty. Key policy insights The value of reducing uncertainty about solar geoengineering is comparable to the value of reducing uncertainty about other key climate factors, such as equilibrium climate sensitivity. The benefits of research that reduces uncertainty about solar geoengineering may be more than a thousand times larger than the cost of a large-scale research programme. Under-confidence in solar geoengineering’s effectiveness can be as costly as over-confidence. The majority of the benefits of reduced uncertainty come from reducing climate damages rather than from slowing emissions reductions.
abstract_zh: 太阳地球工程（SG）如果用于补充减排和碳移除，或许能够降低气候风险。然而，是否应继续开展研究以减少其不确定性，仍存在争议。本文利用一个综合评估模型，估计了减少SG有效性不确定性的信息价值。我们发现，到2030年将不确定性降低三分之一的价值约为4.5万亿美元，其中大部分来自气候损害的减少，而非减排成本的降低。减少SG有效性的不确定性，其价值与减少气候敏感性不确定性的价值相近。我们分析了对SG过度自信的成本，这种过度自信会导致减排不足和SG使用过多。与对SG道德风险问题的担忧相一致，我们发现过度自信的偏误是一个严重且代价高昂的问题；但我们也发现，过早排除SG的信心不足，其代价可能与过度自信大致相当。有偏差的判断在两个方向上都是代价高昂的。硬币有两面。我们的分析定量地展示了围绕SG的风险-风险权衡，并强调了能够降低不确定性的研究的价值。主要政策启示：减少太阳地球工程不确定性的价值，可与减少其他关键气候因素（如平衡气候敏感性）不确定性的价值相媲美。减少太阳地球工程不确定性研究所带来的效益，可能比大规模研究计划的成本高出一千多倍。对太阳地球工程有效性的信心不足，其代价可能与过度自信相当。减少不确定性的大部分效益来自于减少气候损害，而非减缓排放减少的速度。

title: Climate econometric models indicate solar geoengineering would reduce inter-country income inequality
abstract: Exploring heterogeneity in the economic impacts of solar geoengineering is a fundamental step towards understanding the risk tradeoff associated with a geoengineering option. To evaluate impacts of solar geoengineering and greenhouse gas-driven climate change on equal terms, we apply macroeconomic impact models that have been widely applied to climate change impacts assessment. Combining historical evidence with climate simulations of mean annual temperature and precipitation, we project socio-economic outcomes under high anthropogenic emissions for stylized climate scenarios in which global temperatures are stabilized or over-cooled by blocking solar radiation. We find impacts of climate changes on global GDP-per-capita by the end of the century are temperature-driven, highly dispersed, and model dependent. Across all model specifications, however, income inequality between countries is lower with solar geoengineering. Consistent reduction in inter-country inequality can inform discussions of the distribution of impacts of solar geoengineering, a topic of concern in geoengineering ethics and governance debates.
abstract_zh: 探讨太阳地球工程经济影响的异质性，是理解地球工程方案风险权衡的一个基本步骤。为了在同等条件下评估太阳地球工程和温室气体驱动的气候变化的影响，我们应用了已被广泛用于气候变化影响评估的宏观经济影响模型。结合历史证据与年平均气温和降水的气候模拟，我们在高排放情景下，针对通过阻挡太阳辐射使全球气温保持稳定或过度降温的程式化气候情景，预测了社会经济结果。我们发现，到本世纪末，气候变化对全球人均GDP的影响由温度驱动，高度分散，并依赖于模型设定。然而，在所有模型设定下，若实施太阳地球工程，国家之间的收入不平等都会更低。国家间不平等的持续降低，可以为讨论太阳地球工程影响的分配问题提供依据，这也是地球工程伦理和治理辩论中关注的话题。

title: Towards Deep De-carbonization: An Energy Service-System Framework
Solar geoengineering economics: From incredible to inevitable and half-way back
